description_en: Changes the configuration of a database proxy for an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于变更RDS数据库代理实例相关配置
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-proxy-instance --db-instance-id rm-t4n3a0000 --db-proxy-instance-type exclusive --db-proxy-instance-num 2 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBProxyInstance

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The database proxy type. Valid values:

common: general-purpose database proxy
exclusive (default): dedicated database proxy
parameters.help_zh:
数据库代理实例类型，取值：
common：通用型代理
exclusive：独享型代理（默认）
parameters.name: db_proxy_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of database proxies. If you set this parameter to 0, the database proxy feature is disabled for the instance. Valid values: 1 to 16.

The capability of the database proxy feature to process requests increases with the number of database proxies that are enabled. You can monitor the load on the instance and specify an appropriate number of database proxies based on the load monitoring data
parameters.help_zh:
设置代理实例数量。当取值为0的时候，表示这个实例关闭此种类型代理服务。取值：1~16。
更多的代理实例能处理更多的请求，您可以根据监控数据了解代理实例的负载，然后设置合理的代理实例数量
parameters.name: db_proxy_instance_num

parameters.help_en:
The effective time. Valid values:

Immediate: The effective time is immediate.
MaintainTime: The effective time is within the maintenance window. For more information, see ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime.
SpecificTime: The effective time is a specified point in time.

Default value: MaintainTime
parameters.help_zh:
生效时间，取值：

Immediate：立即生效。
MaintainTime：在可运维时间段内生效，请参见ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime。
SpecificTime：指定时间生效。

默认值：MaintainTime
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en:
The point in time that you want to specify. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

If the EffectiveTime parameter is set to SpecificTime, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 指定时间生效。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 EffectiveTime为SpecificTime时，该参数必传
parameters.name: effective_specific_time

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: A deprecated parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: db_proxy_engine_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch in the destination zone. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610431.html operation to query existing vSwitches.

Only database proxies for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances that use cloud disks can be migrated to different zones
parameters.name: vswitchids

fields.help_en:
The number of cpu cores for the node, valid values: 1 to 16.
This parameter is required when selecting DBProxyNodes
fields.help_zh:
节点CPU核数，取值1~16。
选择DBProxyNodes时，该参数必选
fields.name: cpu_cores

fields.help_en:
The number of proxy nodes in the availability zone, valid values: 1 to 16.
This parameter is required when selecting DBProxyNodes
fields.help_zh:
可用区中代理节点数量，取值1~2。
选择DBProxyNodes时，该参数必选
fields.name: node_counts

fields.help_en:
The id of the availability zone where the node is located.
This parameter is required when selecting DBProxyNodes
fields.help_zh:
节点所在的可用区 ID。
选择DBProxyNodes时，该参数必选
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
List of proxy nodes.

This parameter must be passed when the current proxy instance is deployed in multiple availability zones
parameters.help_zh:
代理节点列表。
当前代理实例为多可用区部署时，该参数必传
parameters.name: db_proxy_nodes

fields.help_en:
The proxy connection address ID. You can obtain it through the DescribeDBProxyEndpoint interface.

This parameter is required when MigrateAZ is selected
fields.help_zh:
代理连接地址 ID。可以通过接口 DescribeDBProxyEndpoint 获取。
选择MigrateAZ时，该参数必选
fields.name: db_proxy_endpoint_id

fields.help_en:
The target VSwitchId corresponding to the proxy instance migration.

This parameter is required when MigrateAZ is selected
fields.help_zh:
代理实例迁移对应的目标VSwitch ID。
选择MigrateAZ时，该参数必选
fields.name: dest_vswitch_id

fields.help_en: The target vpc id corresponding to the proxy instance migration
fields.help_zh:
代理实例迁移对应的目标VPC ID。
选择MigrateAZ时，该参数必选
fields.name: dest_vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of available zones for migration agents.

Currently, only RDS MySQL cloud disk version agent instance migration is supported
parameters.help_zh:
迁移代理可用区列表。
当前仅支持RDS MySQL云盘版代理实例迁移可用区
parameters.name: migrate_az
